question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom:

**Make a clean breast of it**
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To admit something honestly". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Make a clean breast of it"** means to confess or admit something openly and honestly, especially a wrongdoing or mistake. (ईमानदारी से कुछ स्वीकार करना) • **Example:** He decided to make a clean breast of it and told his boss about the mistake he made in the project. • **"Admit something honestly"** means to openly acknowledge or confess the truth without hiding anything. (सच को ईमानदारी से स्वीकार करना) • **Example:** She admitted honestly that she was the one who accidentally broke the vase. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "To admit something honestly". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: To run away quickly** (जल्दी से भाग जाना) • **Example:** The thief ran away quickly as soon as he saw the police. • **Option 3: To change sides** (पक्ष बदलना) • **Example:** During the debate, he suddenly changed sides and began supporting the opposition. • **Option 4: To start a new job** (नई नौकरी शुरू करना) • **Example:** She started a new job at a multinational company last week. 3e:Ta94, The correct answer is: **Sybarite**.
